heading: Before any work on a grave
body: The sign at the pedestrian gate states the Trust’s position plainly:
quoteText: No Additions or Alterations are permitted in this Cemetery without the express permission of the Cemetery Trust.
quoteSource: Sign on the Piper Street pedestrian gate
bodyAfter: If you are planning a memorial, a new inscription, plantings or any work on an existing grave, please contact the Trust first.
